lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: shòu piào jī zài rù kǒu páng biān
lines.en: The ticket machine is next to the entrance.
lines.fr: Le distributeur de tickets est à côté de l'entrée.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: wǒ yào mǎi yì zhāng piào
lines.en: I want to buy a ticket.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ àn zhè ge àn niǔ jiù hǎo
lines.en: Just press this button.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: jī qì huì zì jǐ suàn ma
lines.en: Does the machine calculate it automatically?

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.zh: 對，你要拿一份路線圖嗎？
lines.pinyin: duì nǐ yào ná yí fèn lù xiàn tú ma
lines.en: Right, do you want to take a route map?
lines.fr: Oui, tu veux prendre un plan de ligne ?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: hǎo xiè xiè nǐ bāng wǒ
lines.en: Okay, thanks for helping me!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: yuè tái zài lóu shàng
lines.en: The platform is upstairs.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: yào zěn me zǒu bǐ jiào kuài
lines.en: How do I get there faster?

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ kàn shàng miàn de zhǐ biāo jiù hǎo
lines.en: Just look at the sign up above.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: wǎng dōng de zài zhōng jiān ma
lines.en: Is the eastbound one in the middle?
lines.fr: Celui vers l'est est au milieu ?

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: duì zhí zǒu jiù huì dào le
lines.en: Yes, go straight and you'll get there.
lines.fr: Oui, va tout droit et tu y seras.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: hǎo wǒ zhī dào le xiè xiè
lines.en: Okay, I understand, thanks!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ yào qù tái zhōng ma
lines.en: Are you going to Taichung?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: bú shì wǒ yào qù yī yuàn
lines.en: No, I'm going to the hospital.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: yī yuàn de dì zhǐ shì shén me
lines.en: What's the hospital's address?

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: zhōng shān lù sān duàn shí wǔ hào
lines.en: Zhongshan Road, Section 3, Number 15.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: ō wǒ zhī dào nà tiáo lù
lines.en: Oh, I know that road.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: tài hǎo le xiè xiè nǐ
lines.en: Great, thank you!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: xiàn zài shì lián jià rén hěn duō
lines.en: It's a long weekend, there are lots of people.
lines.fr: C'est un week-end prolongé, il y a plein de monde.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: wèi shén me jīn tiān tè bié duō rén
lines.en: Why are there so many people today?
lines.fr: Pourquoi il y a autant de monde aujourd'hui ?

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: yīn wèi kuài dào nóng lì xīn nián le
lines.en: Because Lunar New Year is coming soon.
lines.fr: Parce que le Nouvel An lunaire approche.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: zhè yí tàng chē xiāng yǐ jīng mǎn le
lines.en: This train car is already full.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: xià yí tàng yīng gāi huì bǐ jiào kōng
lines.en: The next one should be less crowded.
lines.fr: Le prochain devrait être moins bondé.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: hǎo nà wǒ zài děng yí xià
lines.en: Okay, I'll wait a bit then.
lines.fr: D'accord, je vais attendre un peu.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: gāng gāng yǒu chéng kè zài bào yuàn
lines.en: Just now a passenger was complaining.
lines.fr: Un passager se plaignait à l'instant.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: tā zài bào yuàn shén me shì qíng
lines.en: What was he complaining about?

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: chē wù diǎn bú shì wǒ néng guǎn de
lines.en: The train delay isn't something I can manage.
lines.fr: Le retard du train, je ne peux pas le gérer.

lines.speaker: player
lines.pinyin: zhè yàng a wǒ hěn jīng yà
lines.en: I see, I'm quite surprised.
lines.fr: Je vois, je suis assez surpris.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.pinyin: nǐ hěn ài liáo tiān hěn wài xiàng
lines.en: You love chatting, you're very outgoing.
lines.fr: Tu adores discuter, tu es très extraverti.

lines.speaker: player
lines.zh: 對啊，我喜歡認識新朋友！
lines.pinyin: duì a wǒ xǐ huān rèn shì xīn péng yǒu
lines.en: Yeah, I like meeting new friends!
lines.fr: Ouais, j'aime rencontrer de nouveaux amis !
